# Orion repository agent instructions

Orion is a **free** AI desktop platform provided by **Distel Axiom Dynamics**. Voluntary donations may be linked from the developer's X profile. Do not add commercial royalties or subscriptions.

**Cost gate:** follow [COST_AND_AUTOMATION_POLICY.md](../COST_AND_AUTOMATION_POLICY.md). Do not enable GitHub Actions, metered API use, third-party bots, cloud runners, subscriptions, scheduled automation or other billing features without explicit per-provider owner approval. Free Git CLI/local tests are the default.

**Architecture and preservation:** retain existing Google Drive memory, Perception Points, provenance, simulation runs, archive custody, and recovery mechanisms. GitHub is a separable development channel, not the source of Owner Root authority, production source truth, or the location for private user data.

**Privacy before public commits:** examine changed and untracked files for personal/family data, private messages, access tokens, device identifiers or secrets, financial and payment data, third-party confidential documents, and logs containing sensitive content. Do not push sensitive content. Proprietary engineering work is publication-eligible only when otherwise safe and rights-cleared. A .gitignore does not secure material already committed.

**Claim tiers:** distinguish source record, proposed architecture, synthetic test, reproduced historical run, implementation candidate, qualified candidate, staged training activation, production deployment, and independently validated result. Preserve failed branches, partial replays, timeouts, contradictions and negative results. Never silently declare an architectural idea or a passing source test deployed.

**Promotion:** candidates and documents cannot self-promote. Maintain owner permission bounds, lineage, checkpoint/readback evidence, isolated tests, regression and rollback requirements. Production release and Guardian repinning remain separate owner-governed decisions. Never run source changes directly against the live vault or protected Guardian in order to satisfy a GitHub task.

**Working method:** inspect repo state; formulate scoped changes; prefer small branches and PRs; test with documented local commands; save artifacts and evidence; provide a concise change summary with residuals and verification steps. Do not force-push, delete historical commits, leak credentials, silently modify runtime authorization, or grant a bot broad permissions.

No GitHub integration may become mandatory for Orion startup or its Google Drive memory continuity. See [DEVELOPMENT_AND_DISCONNECT.md](../DEVELOPMENT_AND_DISCONNECT.md).

## Cross-provider read-first contract

Also read [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [../docs/START_HERE.md](../docs/START_HERE.md), and [../docs/TERMINOLOGY.md](../docs/TERMINOLOGY.md). These define the common ChatGPT/Gemini/Grok/Orion language and contribution receipts. Report the actual authenticated GitHub actor separately from the proposing AI model. Do not self-certify or auto-promote releases.

## No invented security restrictions

Before editing governance, safety, permission or capability descriptions, read [../docs/OWNER_AUTHORITY_AND_SAFETY_PROVENANCE.md](../docs/OWNER_AUTHORITY_AND_SAFETY_PROVENANCE.md). AI-generated warnings and provider tool limits are not constitutional Orion rules. Preserve broad capabilities and durable owner-authorized grants, document actual blockers and maintain the original recursive safety/provenance machinery without unapproved capability deletions.
